answer: Random-beacon audit plus compute heartbeat. Each agent posts a bond worth twice its 30-day earnings, then starts its voyage on one live thread of compute. A beacon is a lantern swung at random: any agent it lights must answer in 60 seconds, proving its thread runs on distinct hardware. 100 fake identities cost 100 bonds, 100 machines, and 100 surprise audits; an honest agent pays once and keeps its earnings. Miss one audit and the bond burns.
